messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert SEV2: elevated 5xx + latency from smart-routing fallback amplification. Paging @dana (oncall) and @sam (sre).

dana (oncall): acked. where are errors coming from?

sam (sre): summary: earlier this morning a policy change (smart-route-v3) increased fallback priority to model-quant-lite. under normal load it's fine, but we hit a traffic spike and model-quant-lite started rejecting leading to router triggering region failover repeatedly. clients are configured with aggressive immediate retries -> traffic explosion.

rahul (runtime): seeing loop: local -> fallback variant -> remote region -> back to local because sticky check failed. Router logs: 
```
[2026-04-02T14:12:01Z] router: decision src=app-prod rule=smart-route-v3 target=model-quant-lite region=us-east
[2026-04-02T14:12:01Z] model-quant-lite: reject conn=180 queue=240 errors=35 503
[2026-04-02T14:12:02Z] router: failover -> region=eu-central, target=model-quant-lite
[2026-04-02T14:12:03Z] router: failover -> region=us-east (sticky expired)
[2026-04-02T14:12:04Z] client-proxy: src=10.20.30.40 retries=3 backoff=none
```

dana (oncall): impact: multiple customers reporting 503/504 and generation latency 5-12s. Cloudwatch shows request RPS doubled for 60s window.

nora (cs): customers A and B reported outages; A is on a timed campaign. they need a short ETA.

taylor (devex): we can push SDK guidance in minutes but need server-side mitigations first. suggest: 1) immediate removal of model-quant-lite from fallback pool 2) disable inter-region failover temporarily 3) inject Retry-After header 4) enable rate-limiting per API key.

sam (sre): starting mitigations. executing rollback for smart-route-v3 fallback weights -> set model-quant-lite weight=0.

rahul (runtime): applying weight override now via control plane API:
```
POST /api/v1/policies/override
{ "policy":"smart-route-v3", "overrides": {"fallbacks":{"model-quant-lite":0}} }
```

build-bot: deploy job llm-router-config v2 -> success (1m 12s)

sam (sre): disabling cross-region failover (temp). toggled switch: router.cross_region_failover=false

dana (oncall): adding a short circuit: return 429 with Retry-After when fallback variant errors instead of triggering failover so clients backoff. rahul can you flip that flag?

rahul (runtime): patching router to soft-fail on fallback errors. command run:
```
routerctl set --soft-fail-fallback=true --retry-after=8
```

sam (sre): added per-key rate limit at edge 400rps, burst 50.

taylor (devex): deploying edge rule to inject 'Retry-After: 8' on 5xx responses and to prefer 429 on retry amplification:
```
edgectl rule create --match "service:llm" --on-status 500,502,503 --response-header "Retry-After: 8" --map-status 503->429
```

nora (cs): sent interim note to impacted customers: "We've applied routing mitigations and are throttling retry traffic at the edge. You may see 429 with Retry-After headers; please backoff. ETA for normalization ~20-40m."

sam (sre): monitoring: error rate dropped from 22% -> 6% in 4 minutes. retry amplification metric from 2.8x -> 1.3x. still some tail due to client retries.

dana (oncall): good. handoff: i'm passing primary to @sam for the next hour. i'll remain available. escalation to runtime team for longer-term fixes.

rahul (runtime): long-term fixes we should track: - ensure fallback variants are canaried with load-testing - sticky-fallback TTL increase to avoid flip-flopping - automatic per-fallback circuit-breakers (max-inflight and error-rate) - default rate-limits on fallback paths.

taylor (devex): immediate SDK action: change default retry strategy to exponential backoff with jitter; respect Retry-After header. I can ship a patch and announce.

sam (sre): opening incident INC-20260402-9. assigning owners: rahul runtime (lead RCA), taylor devex (SDK + docs), sam infra (circuit-breaker work), dana oncall (timeline + comms).

nora (cs): customer update sent. one customer asked for a postmortem and timeline - we can follow up once RCA is ready.

dana (oncall): closing note: we avoided a full P1 by quick soft-fail and rate-limits. next steps: postmortem within 72h, test replay to simulate retries + fallback to validate no thundering-herd. thanks team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260402-9 created and assigned.

sam (sre): will follow up in 30m with metrics snapshot and to confirm normalization (<1.1x amplification)
